description: This file defines the LazyOpenStream class, which implements stream lazily opening a file upon first IO operation within the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 library.

classes.name: LazyOpenStream
classes.description: Implements a stream that opens a file lazily upon the first IO operation, adhering to PSR-7 StreamInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a LazyOpenStream with the filename and mode for opening the file.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates the underlying stream by opening the file lazily.
